hypothesis_text: Extreme positive funding rate dislocations (funding_rate_zscore_30d > 0.8) reflect heavily crowded leveraged long carry trades. When buying momentum exhausts and aggressive taker selling emerges (taker_buy_ratio_1h < 0.53) under non-zero order book friction (spread_bps > 0.4), the carry trade unwinds via forced liquidations and long de-risking, resulting in negative forward price returns over the 1h to 4h intermediate horizon.
narrative: In cryptocurrency perpetual futures, a persistent positive funding rate requires long position holders to pay periodic financing fees to short counter-parties. When funding reaches extreme statistical elevations (z > 22 on SOLUSDT as observed in A4_SOLUSDT_798, and z-score > 0.8 over trailing 30 days), market participants are heavily skewed towards levered long positions. This position overhang is fragile: long holders incur steady negative cash-flow carry costs. As price momentum halts and aggressive taker sellers begin hitting the bid (taker_buy_ratio_1h falling below 0.53, confirmed by gate_low), marginal levered longs are forced to close positions to stem bleeding carry and drawdown. In markets where order book spreads are non-zero (spread_bps > 0.4), market makers widen quotes, exacerbating the impact of forced long liquidations and sell-stop executions. Furthermore, when open interest had expanded prior to the unwind (oi_change_pct_4h > 1.5 sigma), the volume of long leverage that must exit is substantial, deepening the temporary price dislocation into a sustained multi-hour mean-reversion move.
research_rationale: The anchor A4_SOLUSDT_798 (value = 0.00138731, effect_size = 22.85, n_effective = 208, p_value = 1.57e-115, observed at 2025-02-22T00:14:00+00:00) represents an extreme positive funding dislocation on SOLUSDT. The funding distribution shows wide dispersion (std = 0.000431 across SOLUSDT, with tail inflation of 1023.6 relative to normal). In the cemetery for funding_rate_zscore_30d, the dominant kill code is T0.04-IC-STAT (785 of 962 trials), demonstrating that raw unconditioned funding carries weak linear signal across all market regimes. However, when paired with taker_buy_ratio_1h (role: trigger), the cemetery reveals 9 T1 survivors (the highest surviving pair in the catalog), and the prior table explicitly specifies gate_low/gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h when the anchor is positive (n=36, sufficient confidence). We follow this prior by committing gate_low on taker_buy_ratio_1h, which projects to 260 scored days in T1 (reaching the 250-day floor). Additionally, following the prior for exposure, we include gate_high on oi_change_pct_4h (projecting to 254 scored days in T1, reaching the floor), ensuring the mechanism conditions on elevated open interest overhang. We avoid long_short_ratio_zscore_7d as an authored gate because probe_partner showed its gate_high projects to only 186 T1 days, failing the 250-day floor. In expression_lab, the multi-feature predicate (funding_rate_zscore_30d > 0.8 and taker_buy_ratio_1h < 0.53 and spread_bps > 0.4) was evaluated on A4_SOLUSDT_798 and locked as XLC_b9df08e8bc70. It holds on the anchor event, spans 222 independent active days, matches 39 anchor events with a lift of 1.350 over panel match rate, and clears the T1 event scoring floor with 2438 projected T1 event observations at the 60m horizon. We select search_scope='full' to explore the automatic grid expansions over these validated partner columns.
